faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting the recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Army Public School, Yol (H.P.) (APS YOL) for filling various teaching positions for the academic session.

faq.question: Q2. What are the posts available in APS YOL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available posts include PGT, TGT, PRT, and Balvatika Teacher (Female) across different subject specializations as notified by the school management.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are announced?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies available for various teaching posts under this recruitment notification released by Army Public School, Yol.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form along with required documents and demand draft is 09 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for APS YOL jobs?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly offline. Candidates need to download the form, fill it out, attach documents, and send it by post to the school.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: Yes, all candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 250/- via a demand draft drawn in favour of Army Public School, Yol payable at Yol.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes shortlisting based on experience, a written or aptitude test, followed by a personal interview for qualifying candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What are the general qualification requirements?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess the relevant graduate or post-graduate qualifications along with fluency in English and good computer skills as mandated by APS.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: You can download the official notification and application form from the official website of the school at www.apsyol.org or obtain it from the school office.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: These positions are offered on a contract, ad-hoc, or panel basis under the Army Public School management system in Himachal Pradesh.
